sentence: This project builds computer tools that watch video from several camera views and explain what they find in ways that people can understand.
This project studies the geometry and topology of a kind of mathematical group by linking it to a closely related kind of group.
This project builds a robot that combines flight and legged mobility so it can inspect roofs on its own.
This project studies how a credential in data science and artificial intelligence changes the perspectives of disciplines and the culture of institutions.
This project builds methods that use femtosecond laser beams and optical microscopy to study how energy carriers carry heat in nanomaterials.
This project uses computer simulations and machine learning to predict how plants take up contaminants from the soil and carry them to edible parts.
This project builds computer models of the visual system that have a foveated retina, move their eyes and use recordings from the brain.
This project uses ideas from physics about symmetries to design machine learning models for problems in cosmology and climate science.
This project uses computer simulations to study how electric fields and solvents steer chemical reactions that turn methane gas into methanol inside zeolites.
This project builds a way to send video through the human body instead of a wire, so an augmented reality headset can use little power.
This project tests whether native harvester ants sense chemicals from invasive Argentine ants and change where and when they look for food to avoid them.
This project studies how species traits shape synchrony, meaning how the abundances of plants rise and fall together across places and time.
This project builds deep neural networks that see more like people, using tests of human vision to guide their training.
This project plans a shared open-source ecosystem of robot simulators, control libraries and educational modules for construction automation and robotics.
This project studies how the four-eyed fish Anableps anableps develops eyes that see above and below water, and which genes shape this.
This project sets up a smart manufacturing training system that runs simulations of real-world assembly processes.
